hero.title: Financial Control
hero.description: Organize your finances in the browser using IndexedDB. Data in this MVP stays in this browser profile, without a remote account.

features.title: Why choose a Local-First architecture?
features.subtitle: Unlike traditional cloud systems, Zevault puts you in control. We eliminate latency and the risk of third-party data leaks.

storage.title: Local Storage
storage.description: We use your browser's native database. This means the system works offline and loads instantly, without waiting for slow APIs.

privacy.title: Data in your browser
privacy.description: This MVP does not send your transactions to its own backend. Protection also depends on your device and browser profile security.

backup.title: Backup and Portability
backup.description: Export a JSON file to keep a copy or move your data. Encryption is not implemented for the exported file.

comparison.title: Your financial data shouldn't live on someone else's computer.
comparison.description: Most financial apps store your transactions on shared servers. Zevault flips this logic. The browser is the operating system, and the database is yours.
comparison.compliant: You control export and removal of local data

terminal.syncDisabled: > Syncing disabled by default for security.

cta.title: Ready to take back control?
cta.description: Start organizing your finances now. No signup, no credit card, just pure software.
